periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Primary axis is angled approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial plane, sloping towards the rostrum.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Vertically elongated oval with a visual height-to-width ratio of approximately 1.5:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering with the geometric center located in the upper two-thirds of the patch.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped posterior boundary across the dorsal midline with no sharp vertex.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band occupies approximately 35% of the visible torso height between the shoulder and the lower abdomen.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide gap between pinnae, approximately equivalent to 1.8 times the width of a single ear region.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly rounded, semicircular convex curvature at the superior margins.

other_distinctive_markers: Notable brownish-tan hue in the ventral and lower limb fur, contrasting with the high-luminance white of the cranial and dorsal regions.
